Looking at the data, I can see a clear pattern: iPhone searches spiked dramatically in September 2026 (peaking at 54.49 on 9/12) due to the iPhone 18 Pro announcement, then began declining (51.03 â 45.8). The other four brands were temporarily suppressed during this spike and are recovering toward their pre-spike baselines.

**Key observations:**
- **iPhone**: Declining from spike peak. The decay accelerated (â3.46 then â5.23), but should decelerate further as the announcement hype fades. Pre-spike baseline was ~40-41. I expect ~42.
- **Tesla**: Nearly fully recovered to its ~9.3-9.5 baseline. Model 3 refresh (Oct 1) and upcoming Roadster demo (Oct 15) provide modest support.
- **Samsung**: Slow recovery from the iPhone squeeze. Was on a declining trend pre-spike (14.18â11.72). Galaxy Tab S12 launch (Oct 1) may help slightly. Expect ~10.8.
- **Netflix**: Nearly recovered to its ~17-18 baseline. October new releases (The Diplomat S4, movie additions) provide support. Expect ~17.8.
- **Disney**: Still recovering (17.56 vs pre-spike ~19-20). Recovery rate was ~+1.7/week. VisionQuest (MCU series) and Halloween content on Hulu should boost. Expect ~19.9.

The shares must sum to 100, so as iPhone declines ~3.8 points from 45.8, those points redistribute primarily to Disney and Samsung which have the most recovery room.
